title: Constitution built-in document type: shape rules enforced by lore check, singleton, template (OPAG-425 R1, R2, R3, R4, R9)
description: Binding record: opum-doc main 7831fff, docs/adr/add-constitution-and-constants-document-types-to-lore.md. Add built-in type Constitution (slug constitution) per R1: a lore-only change, no OKF spec change; if the OKF 0.1 legacy-six-type freeze is load-bearing, argue it to opum-agent with the reason rather than exempting silently. R2: at most one per bundle, checked by lore check (new singleton logic). R3: its rules run in lore check, not only lore validate (a second call site beside check's per-file type peek, check.ts ~478-490). R4 shape: frontmatter version (SemVer), ratified and last_amended (ISO, last_amended >= ratified), amendment_authority; required sections Principles, Governance, Amendment log; optional Constraints, Quality gates, Exceptions; each principle a level-3 heading 'P<n>. <Name>', stable id never reused, with at least one uppercase RFC 2119/8174 keyword, a 'Rationale:' and a 'Check:'; the Amendment log's top row matches version and last_amended; no unresolved template placeholders; a WARNING above 150 lines in Principles. R9: 'lore new constitution' template with RFC 8174 boilerplate, one example principle with MUST/Rationale/Check, a Governance section naming agent-drafted, human-ratified amendment by PR linked to an ADR, the Amendment log, and a comment recommending CODEOWNERS required review (lore cannot enforce who edits, and says so).

acceptanceCriteria.text: lore check fails a Constitution missing each required section or field, a principle without a keyword, Rationale or Check, an Amendment log whose top row disagrees with version/last_amended, an unresolved placeholder, and a second Constitution in the bundle; it warns above 150 Principles lines; each proven by a test
lore new constitution produces a document that lore check passes, and a test proves a valid Constitution passes
bun test and bun run lore check exit 0
